use_cases: Air and moisture barrier in residential home construction to reduce draughts and protect insulation
Draught-proofing and secondary weather protection on shed and garage walls
not_for: Roof sarking without verification of roof duty rating
retrieval.rag_summary:
Misc Wrap
represents pliable building membranes and wall wraps utilized across Australian
residential and commercial wall construction. Available as vapour-permeable
(breathable) spunbonded membranes or reflective foil laminates, these products
protect structural frames from wind-driven rain, dust, and draughts during and
after construction. Compliant with AS/NZS 4200.1 and AS/NZS 4200.2 standards,
they form a secondary weather barrier while managing condensation risk behind
external claddings.
